statement: The v0 rubric (five properties, Stages 0-2) has recorded assessments of one listed project: applied-butterfly-mult, a benchmark project, assessed as a nomination and again after setup (Stage 1, self-assessed, 2026-10-17). The nomination's projected grades held for Coordination, Verification and Steering; Orientation and Review came out one grade higher. Records for integer-mult-bounds and the hub itself are in review as PRs. Adapters were tested on six third-party repositories, each probed with and without its adapter. Assessment records have a schema, and a weekly hub check flags stale listings. integer-mult-bounds' informal Stage 1 from 2026-10-16 has no record and doesn't count.
status: One project with merged records, two in review; every record self-assessed, awaiting an independent rerun; thresholds uncalibrated; no donor-tier probe model yet.
scope: Two listed projects with records, of two shapes (benchmark; the hub's own review-only project), plus six unlisted third-party repositories probed for adapter testing. Not yet tested on a replication or conjecture-style listing, or with a donor-tier probe model.

assumptions.statement: Probe answers on the same commit agree. Five assessments of applied-butterfly-mult at 3d2fc58 gave identical grades on every property (issue #4); one repo and one probe model so far.
The thresholds in spec §3.2 are sensible (uncalibrated).
A routine reassessment costs about two short donor sessions. Measured once: an assess session took 5-10 minutes of agent time, plus about 3 minutes per probe.
